public_relationship_text: Numina Ventures is Numina's investment and incubation vertical. Numina Foundation is Numina's charitable vertical, connecting its work in STEM and emerging technology in education. Sam Kott advises the existing Kott Family Fund at the Community Foundation of the Fox River Valley. Charitable contributions go directly to the Foundation through its official fund giving page; the Foundation controls fund assets and distribution decisions. Numina's commercial services and payments remain separate.
